config_app_mapping.description: Configuration mapping that assigns each tracked Facebook page to a canonical game identifier.
config_app_mapping.grain: One active or historical game-to-Facebook-page mapping.

unified_app_id.description: Stable internal identifier for the canonical tracked game.

fb_page_id.description: Facebook page identifier associated with the source page.

app_name.description: App name from the source or transformation pipeline.

is_active.description: Is active from the source or transformation pipeline.

valid_from.description: Valid from from the source or transformation pipeline.

valid_to.description: Valid to from the source or transformation pipeline.

source_updated_at.description: Timestamp for source updated at; use as an ISO 8601 text value.

relationships.description: One configured Facebook page can produce many raw Facebook posts.

examples.question: List active tracked Facebook pages.
examples.sql: SELECT unified_app_id, fb_page_id, app_name, valid_from, valid_to FROM config_app_mapping WHERE is_active = 1 ORDER BY app_name, fb_page_id LIMIT 50

examples.question: Find all configured Facebook pages for one game.
examples.sql: SELECT unified_app_id, fb_page_id, app_name, is_active FROM config_app_mapping WHERE unified_app_id = 'YOUR_UNIFIED_APP_ID' ORDER BY fb_page_id

raw_fb_posts.description: One row per Facebook post collected from a tracked page. This is the authoritative source for actual Facebook publication time and post engagement metrics.
raw_fb_posts.grain: One Facebook source post, identified by source_post_id.

source_post_id.description: Stable Facebook post identifier from the source system.

unified_app_id.description: Stable internal identifier for the canonical tracked game.

fb_page_id.description: Facebook page identifier associated with the source page.

channel_id.description: Socialdata channel identifier that represents the Facebook page.

channel_name.description: Socialdata display name of the source Facebook channel.

post_type.description: Post type from the source or transformation pipeline.

post_description.description: Post description from the source or transformation pipeline.

duration.description: Duration from the source or transformation pipeline.

link.description: Direct URL of the Facebook post when supplied by the source.

publish_time.description: Actual time when the Facebook post was published by the source page, in ISO 8601 UTC format.

hashtag.description: Hashtag from the source or transformation pipeline.

engagement.description: Source Facebook engagement count, stored as text by the landing schema. Cast to INTEGER before aggregation.

reaction.description: Source Facebook reaction count, stored as text by the landing schema. Cast to INTEGER before aggregation.

comment.description: Source Facebook comment count, stored as text by the landing schema. Cast to INTEGER before aggregation.

share.description: Source Facebook share count, stored as text by the landing schema. Cast to INTEGER before aggregation.

view.description: Source Facebook view count, stored as text by the landing schema. Cast to INTEGER before aggregation.

source_file.description: Raw supplier payload or ingestion field for source file; hidden from analyst queries.

ingested_at.description: Time when this row was ingested into the warehouse, in ISO 8601 UTC format.

relationships.description: Each collected Facebook post has at most one event-detection result.

examples.question: List the latest Facebook posts across tracked games.
examples.sql: SELECT source_post_id, unified_app_id, channel_name, publish_time, CAST(NULLIF(reaction, '') AS INTEGER) AS reaction_count, CAST(NULLIF(comment, '') AS INTEGER) AS comment_count, CAST(NULLIF(share, '') AS INTEGER) AS share_count, CAST(NULLIF(view, '') AS INTEGER) AS view_count, link FROM raw_fb_posts ORDER BY publish_time DESC LIMIT 20

examples.question: Count actual Facebook posts by publication month for one game.
examples.sql: SELECT substr(publish_time, 1, 7) AS publish_month, COUNT(*) AS post_count FROM raw_fb_posts WHERE unified_app_id = 'YOUR_UNIFIED_APP_ID' GROUP BY substr(publish_time, 1, 7) ORDER BY publish_month DESC

raw_st_app_update.grain: One SensorTower app-update record, identified by source_update_id.

country.description: Country from the source or transformation pipeline.

update_time.description: Timestamp for update time; use as an ISO 8601 text value.

update_type.description: Update type from the source or transformation pipeline.

name.description: Name from the source or transformation pipeline.

subtitle.description: Subtitle from the source or transformation pipeline.

short_description.description: Short description from the source or transformation pipeline.

description_text.description: Description text from the source or transformation pipeline.

description_before_text.description: Description before text from the source or transformation pipeline.

description_after_text.description: Description after text from the source or transformation pipeline.

description_diff_html.description: Description diff html from the source or transformation pipeline.

version_before.description: Version before from the source or transformation pipeline.

examples.question: List latest normalized SensorTower app updates.
examples.sql: SELECT source_update_id, unified_app_id, os, app_id, country, update_time, update_type, name, version_before, version_after, ingested_at FROM raw_st_app_update ORDER BY update_time DESC LIMIT 20

examples.question: Count SensorTower app updates by game and operating system.
examples.sql: SELECT unified_app_id, os, COUNT(*) AS update_count FROM raw_st_app_update GROUP BY unified_app_id, os ORDER BY update_count DESC, unified_app_id LIMIT 50

raw_st_version.description: One raw SensorTower version-history record. It is the source history for normalized version changes before event extraction.
raw_st_version.grain: One SensorTower version-history record, identified by source_version_id.

source_version_id.description: Source or internal identifier for source version.

unified_app_id.description: Stable internal identifier for the canonical tracked game.

os.description: Os from the source or transformation pipeline.

app_id.description: Source or internal identifier for app.

country.description: Country from the source or transformation pipeline.

version_time.description: Timestamp for version time; use as an ISO 8601 text value.

version_name.description: Version name from the source or transformation pipeline.

before_version.description: Before version from the source or transformation pipeline.

after_version.description: After version from the source or transformation pipeline.

version_summary.description: Version summary from the source or transformation pipeline.

raw_payload.description: Raw supplier payload or ingestion field for raw payload; hidden from analyst queries.

version_payload.description: Raw supplier payload or ingestion field for version payload; hidden from analyst queries.

source_file.description: Raw supplier payload or ingestion field for source file; hidden from analyst queries.

ingested_at.description: Time when this row was ingested into the warehouse, in ISO 8601 UTC format.

examples.question: List latest SensorTower version-history records.
examples.sql: SELECT source_version_id, unified_app_id, os, app_id, country, version_time, before_version, after_version, version_name, ingested_at FROM raw_st_version ORDER BY version_time DESC LIMIT 20

examples.question: Count version-history records by game and operating system.
examples.sql: SELECT unified_app_id, os, COUNT(*) AS version_record_count FROM raw_st_version GROUP BY unified_app_id, os ORDER BY version_record_count DESC, unified_app_id LIMIT 50

st_app_update_events.description: Candidate game events extracted from SensorTower app-update history. A source candidate can be linked to zero or more unified events through unified_event_sources.
st_app_update_events.grain: One extracted SensorTower app-update event candidate, identified by st_update_event_id.

st_update_event_id.description: Source or internal identifier for st update event.

event_id.description: Source or internal identifier for event.

source_row_id.description: Source or internal identifier for source row.

unified_app_id.description: Stable internal identifier for the canonical tracked game.

event_name.description: Event name extracted from the source record; not yet a canonical unified event name.

estimated_start_date.description: Best available estimated event start date in YYYY-MM-DD format; may be null when unknown.

estimated_end_date.description: Best available estimated event end date in YYYY-MM-DD format; may be null when unknown.

event_description.description: Description extracted from a source candidate.

source_refs.description: JSON-encoded source field for source refs.

relationships.description: One app-update event candidate can contribute to zero or more canonical events.

examples.question: List recently dated app-update event candidates.
examples.sql: SELECT st_update_event_id, unified_app_id, event_name, estimated_start_date, estimated_end_date, event_description FROM st_app_update_events ORDER BY estimated_start_date DESC LIMIT 20

examples.question: Count app-update event candidates by game.
examples.sql: SELECT unified_app_id, COUNT(*) AS event_candidate_count FROM st_app_update_events GROUP BY unified_app_id ORDER BY event_candidate_count DESC LIMIT 50

st_version_events.description: Candidate game events extracted from SensorTower version history. A source candidate can be linked to zero or more unified events through unified_event_sources.
st_version_events.grain: One extracted SensorTower version event candidate, identified by st_version_event_id.

st_version_event_id.description: Source or internal identifier for st version event.

source_row_id.description: Source or internal identifier for source row.

unified_app_id.description: Stable internal identifier for the canonical tracked game.

event_name.description: Event name extracted from the source record; not yet a canonical unified event name.

estimated_start_date.description: Best available estimated event start date in YYYY-MM-DD format; may be null when unknown.

estimated_end_date.description: Best available estimated event end date in YYYY-MM-DD format; may be null when unknown.

event_description.description: Description extracted from a source candidate.

source_refs.description: JSON-encoded source field for source refs.

relationships.description: One version-history event candidate can contribute to zero or more canonical events.

examples.question: List recently dated version-event candidates.
examples.sql: SELECT st_version_event_id, unified_app_id, event_name, estimated_start_date, estimated_end_date, event_description FROM st_version_events ORDER BY estimated_start_date DESC LIMIT 20

examples.question: Count version event candidates by game.
examples.sql: SELECT unified_app_id, COUNT(*) AS event_candidate_count FROM st_version_events GROUP BY unified_app_id ORDER BY event_candidate_count DESC LIMIT 50

post_event_detection.description: One LLM classification result per Facebook post. It records whether a post appears to contain event information; it is not a canonical event table.
post_event_detection.grain: One Facebook post classification, identified by post_id.

post_id.description: Facebook source post identifier used by the event-detection pipeline; equals raw_fb_posts.source_post_id.

unified_app_id.description: Stable internal identifier for the canonical tracked game.

fb_page_id.description: Facebook page identifier associated with the source page.

channel_id.description: Socialdata channel identifier that represents the Facebook page.

page_name.description: Page name from the source or transformation pipeline.

game_name.description: Game name from the source or transformation pipeline.

post_time.description: Actual time when the classified or extracted Facebook post was published, in ISO 8601 UTC format.

contains_event.description: Whether the classifier judged the Facebook post to contain event information: 1=true, 0=false.

detection_confidence.description: LLM event-detection confidence on a 0-to-1 scale.

detection_reason.description: Detection reason from the source or transformation pipeline.

event_signals.description: Event signals from the source or transformation pipeline.

post_text_hash.description: Post text hash from the source or transformation pipeline.

llm_model.description: Llm model from the source or transformation pipeline.

prompt_version.description: Prompt version from the source or transformation pipeline.

processed_at.description: Timestamp for processed at; use as an ISO 8601 text value.

relationships.description: One detected Facebook post can produce zero or more extracted event objects.

examples.question: List the most recent Facebook posts classified as event-related.
examples.sql: SELECT post_id, unified_app_id, game_name, post_time, detection_confidence, detection_reason FROM post_event_detection WHERE contains_event = 1 ORDER BY post_time DESC LIMIT 20

examples.question: Summarize event-detection classification for one game.
examples.sql: SELECT contains_event, COUNT(*) AS post_count, AVG(detection_confidence) AS average_confidence FROM post_event_detection WHERE unified_app_id = 'YOUR_UNIFIED_APP_ID' GROUP BY contains_event ORDER BY contains_event DESC

post_event_objects.description: One event object extracted from an event-related Facebook post. A post may produce multiple event objects before unified-event merging.
post_event_objects.grain: One extracted event object, identified by event_object_id.

event_object_id.description: Source or internal identifier for event object.

post_id.description: Facebook source post identifier used by the event-detection pipeline; equals raw_fb_posts.source_post_id.

unified_app_id.description: Stable internal identifier for the canonical tracked game.

fb_page_id.description: Facebook page identifier associated with the source page.

page_name.description: Page name from the source or transformation pipeline.

game_name.description: Game name from the source or transformation pipeline.

post_time.description: Actual time when the classified or extracted Facebook post was published, in ISO 8601 UTC format.

event_name.description: Event name extracted from the source record; not yet a canonical unified event name.

estimated_start_date.description: Best available estimated event start date in YYYY-MM-DD format; may be null when unknown.

estimated_end_date.description: Best available estimated event end date in YYYY-MM-DD format; may be null when unknown.

event_description.description: Description extracted from a source candidate.

evidence_text.description: Evidence text from the source or transformation pipeline.

extraction_confidence.description: LLM event-object extraction confidence on a 0-to-1 scale.

llm_model.description: Llm model from the source or transformation pipeline.

prompt_version.description: Prompt version from the source or transformation pipeline.

processed_at.description: Timestamp for processed at; use as an ISO 8601 text value.

examples.question: List recently extracted Facebook event objects.
examples.sql: SELECT event_object_id, post_id, unified_app_id, event_name, estimated_start_date, estimated_end_date, extraction_confidence FROM post_event_objects ORDER BY post_time DESC LIMIT 20

examples.question: Find extracted event objects from one Facebook post.
examples.sql: SELECT event_object_id, event_name, estimated_start_date, estimated_end_date, extraction_confidence FROM post_event_objects WHERE post_id = 'YOUR_SOURCE_POST_ID' ORDER BY event_object_id

unified_events.description: Canonical event registry after merging Facebook and SensorTower candidate sources. month_bucket is a reporting bucket for the event record, not the actual publication month of linked Facebook posts.
unified_events.grain: One canonical event, identified by unified_event_id.

unified_event_id.description: Source or internal identifier for unified event.

unified_app_id.description: Stable internal identifier for the canonical tracked game.

month_bucket.description: Canonical event reporting month in YYYY-MM format. It is not a Facebook post publication date.

canonical_event_name.description: Canonical name assigned after candidate-source merging.

event_category.description: Business category assigned to the canonical event.

estimated_start_date.description: Best available estimated event start date in YYYY-MM-DD format; may be null when unknown.

estimated_end_date.description: Best available estimated event end date in YYYY-MM-DD format; may be null when unknown.

canonical_event_description.description: Canonical description assigned after source merging.

anchor_source_type.description: Anchor source type from the source or transformation pipeline.

merge_confidence.description: Confidence for merge confidence on a 0-to-1 scale.

merge_model.description: Merge model from the source or transformation pipeline.

prompt_version.description: Prompt version from the source or transformation pipeline.

created_at.description: Timestamp for created at; use as an ISO 8601 text value.

updated_at.description: Timestamp for updated at; use as an ISO 8601 text value.

relationships.description: One canonical event has one or more source-lineage rows when source evidence is available.

examples.question: List canonical events in one event reporting bucket.
examples.sql: SELECT unified_event_id, unified_app_id, month_bucket, canonical_event_name, event_category, estimated_start_date, estimated_end_date, merge_confidence FROM unified_events WHERE month_bucket = '2026-08' ORDER BY estimated_start_date DESC, canonical_event_name LIMIT 50

examples.question: Count canonical events by game and event reporting bucket.
examples.sql: SELECT unified_app_id, month_bucket, COUNT(*) AS event_count FROM unified_events GROUP BY unified_app_id, month_bucket ORDER BY month_bucket DESC, event_count DESC LIMIT 100

unified_event_sources.description: Lineage table linking canonical events to their source candidates. source_id is polymorphic and must always be interpreted together with source_type; source_post_id is only populated for Facebook sources.
unified_event_sources.grain: One canonical-event-to-source link, uniquely identified by unified_event_id, source_type, and source_id.

unified_event_id.description: Source or internal identifier for unified event.

source_type.description: Source-table discriminator for source_id: fb_post, st_app_update_event, or st_version_event.

source_id.description: Polymorphic source identifier. Interpret it with source_type before joining to a source table.

source_time.description: Relevant timestamp carried from the linked source; its exact meaning depends on source_type.

source_post_id.description: Stable Facebook post identifier from the source system.

source_confidence.description: Confidence assigned to this source-to-event link on a 0-to-1 scale.

relationships.description: A Facebook lineage row links to its raw Facebook post only when source_type is fb_post.
Every lineage row belongs to exactly one canonical event.

examples.question: List Facebook posts linked to canonical events.
examples.sql: SELECT unified_event_id, source_id, source_post_id, source_time, source_confidence FROM unified_event_sources WHERE source_type = 'fb_post' ORDER BY source_time DESC LIMIT 20

examples.question: List all source lineage for one canonical event.
examples.sql: SELECT source_type, source_id, source_post_id, source_time, source_confidence FROM unified_event_sources WHERE unified_event_id = 'YOUR_UNIFIED_EVENT_ID' ORDER BY source_type, source_time DESC
